column1: # MAIN: recreated functions whose source name is not the Ghidra name, or whose address Ghidra's list lacks (T24):
# source name -> original address, with the evidence. tools/equiv_main_emu.py checks the function against that address.

column3: evidence

FUN_fff8fd84: SETPSW I unless PSW.PM [fact]; called by bsp_swint_execute_task for nesting
FUN_fff8fd9b: (PSW & 0x0F000000) >> 24 [fact]
FUN_fff8fdb8: MVTIPL #level through a 16-entry table [fact]

FUN_fff90046 copies the callback of 0x20194[vector] to *out [fact]
FUN_fff90181: R_BSP_InterruptControl commands 5/6, IPL save/raise/restore [fact]
FUN_fff916ac: R_BSP_InterruptControl commands 1/2 for NMI, FPU, bus error [fact]

FUN_fffb9350: the same for IDD (meter_idd) [fact]
FUN_fffb93b9: the same for ALC (meter_alc) [fact]

FUN_fffb959c: the same for S (meter_s) [fact]
FUN_fffc648c: x10 of a channel step with FAST unless 0x1B4E5 = 1 [fact]
